changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO "user"."user" (id, login, password, first_name, type, role, is_verified, is_active, deleted, created_date, last_modified_date, version) SELECT a.id, a.login, a.password, a.full_name, CASE WHEN a.role = 'SUPER_ADMIN' THEN 'SUPER_ADMIN' ELSE 'ADMIN' END, 'ADMIN', TRUE, COALESCE(a.is_active, TRUE), FALSE, COALESCE(a.created_date, NOW()), NOW(), 0 FROM "user".admin a WHERE a.deleted = FALSE ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
